items.description: Lightspeed Retail API allows developers to integrate the Lightspeed Retail system into their applications, enabling the users to access most of everything that is available within their accounts. Lightspeed is a company that provides businesses a way to manage inventory, sell online, connect with suppliers and engage with customers.
Whatsikat Boso shows how Filipino bloggers are feeling right now. It extracts feelings from Filipino blogs. Take a peek into their moods and see how that makes you feel.

The Sanders Standard offers updated media news related to Bernie Sanders. This mashup uses the Webhose.io API to deliver a constant stream of coverage from several sources such as Bloomberg, Politico, and The Guardian.

A CATastrophic Android app by Pura Vida Apps using thecatapi.com Every few seconds another cat will be displayed. This is something for cat lovers! Enjoy! This project has been developed with App Inventor. You can find a screenshot of the relevant parts of the source code here: http://puravidaapps.com/caturday.php
Maps of homes for sale in the Dallas, Fort Worth Texas area.

map.movin360 shows a trip through the city of Berlin. The panoramic movie is synchronized to GoogleMaps. During the virtual tour, you can move the camera around. Get further information and view related photos.
